content:
Created all three chart specifications: the 2025 provincial sales map, monthly sales area chart, and grouped product-category column chart comparing Guangdong and Jiangsu. All values use CNY millions.

Guangdong leads provincial sales at ¥15.8M. Monthly sales rise from ¥1.2M in January to ¥3.5M in December. Electronics leads the listed categories in both regions.

The provincial figures total ¥53.4M, while monthly figures total ¥25.4M; confirm their reporting scope before presenting them as the same annual total.
